For the Petitioners : Mr. Mohit Prakash, Advocate For the State : Mr. Sardhu Mahto, A.P.P.
-----
Oral Order 04 / Dated : 21.07.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

The petitioners named above have been made accused in connection with Raidih P.S. Case No. 55 of 2022 (POCSO Case No. 79 of 2022) for the offence under Sections 376D, 376(DB) 506 of Indian Penal Code and Sections 4, 6, 3, 5 of POCSO Act pending in the court of Special Judge, POCSO, Gumla.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioners that though the petitioners are named in the FIR but during examination of both the victims during trial, the petitioners have not been named.
It is also submitted that seven witnesses have been examined.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the examination of star witnesses cannot be only ground of bail.
The petitioners are named in the FIR and there is direct and specific allegation against them of committing gang rape of the victims.
FIR is supported by the statements of the victims made under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
Considering the stage of trial, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioners on bail.
Accordingly, their prayer for bail is hereby rejected.
